pilgrimage_p1: Ciao, Enda qui... Sto camminando in Europa lungo antichi cammini di pellegrinaggio e visitando alcuni santuari mariani lungo il percorso.
pilgrimage_p2: Vivo in modo semplice e soggiorno in campeggi o rifugi per pellegrini. Durante il cammino mi piace godermi la natura e dedicare il pellegrinaggio a tutte le persone con problemi di salute.
shrine_panel_placeholder: Click a shrine on the map to view information.
shrine_01_info1: Knock Shrine is Ireland’s national Marian shrine, located in County Mayo.
shrine_01_info2: In 1879, villagers witnessed an apparition of the Virgin Mary, Saint Joseph, and Saint John the Evangelist.
shrine_02_info1: Walsingham is one of England’s oldest and most important Marian pilgrimage sites.
shrine_02_info2: Pilgrims have travelled here since the 11th century to honour the Holy House of Nazareth.
shrine_03_info1: The Shrine of Our Lady of Banneux is located in eastern Belgium.
shrine_03_info2: In 1933, the Virgin Mary appeared here to a young girl, presenting herself as the Virgin of the Poor.
shrine_04_info1: Lourdes is one of the most visited pilgrimage sites in the world.
shrine_04_info2: In 1858, Saint Bernadette Soubirous witnessed eighteen apparitions of the Virgin Mary here.
shrine_05_info1: The Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar is located in Zaragoza, Spain.
shrine_05_info2: Tradition holds that the Virgin Mary appeared here to Saint James the Apostle in the first century.
shrine_06_info1: Fátima is Portugal’s most important Marian shrine.
shrine_06_info2: In 1917, three shepherd children witnessed apparitions of Our Lady here.
shrine_07_info1: The Shrine of Our Lady of Europe is located at the southern tip of Gibraltar.
shrine_07_info2: Devotion here dates back many centuries and honours Mary as patroness of Europe.
shrine_08_info1: Loreto is home to the Holy House, believed to be the house of the Virgin Mary.
shrine_08_info2: It has been an important pilgrimage destination since the Middle Ages.
shrine_09_info1: The Sanctuary of Our Lady of Mellieħa is one of Malta’s oldest pilgrimage sites.
shrine_09_info2: Its origins may date back to early Christian times.
shrine_10_info1: Einsiedeln Abbey is Switzerland’s most important Marian shrine.
shrine_10_info2: Pilgrims have visited here for over a thousand years.
shrine_11_info1: Altötting is Germany’s national Marian shrine.
shrine_11_info2: It has been a major place of pilgrimage since the 15th century.
shrine_12_info1: Mariazell is Austria’s most important pilgrimage destination.
shrine_12_info2: Pilgrims from many Central European countries travel here each year.
shrine_13_info1: The National Shrine of Slovenia is located in Brezje.
shrine_13_info2: It is dedicated to Our Lady Help of Christians.
shrine_14_info1: Marija Bistrica is Croatia’s national Marian shrine.
shrine_14_info2: It is known for its statue of the Black Madonna.
shrine_15_info1: Máriapócs is an important Marian pilgrimage site in Hungary.
shrine_15_info2: It is known for its weeping icon of the Virgin Mary.
shrine_16_info1: Mátraverebély-Szentkút is Hungary’s national Marian shrine.
shrine_16_info2: Pilgrims visit the sacred spring and sanctuary located here.
shrine_17_info1: The Marian shrine at Levoča is one of Slovakia’s most important pilgrimage sites.
shrine_17_info2: Pilgrims gather here annually for major religious celebrations.
shrine_18_info1: Csíksomlyó is a major pilgrimage site for Hungarian-speaking Catholics.
shrine_18_info2: The annual Pentecost pilgrimage attracts large numbers of pilgrims.
shrine_19_info1: Częstochowa is home to the famous icon of the Black Madonna.
shrine_19_info2: It is Poland’s most important pilgrimage destination.
shrine_20_info1: Vilnius is home to the Shrine of Our Lady of the Gate of Dawn.
shrine_20_info2: The icon is deeply venerated by pilgrims from across the region.
shrine_21_info1: Zarvanytsia is an important Marian pilgrimage site in Ukraine.
shrine_21_info2: Pilgrims visit the shrine and its healing spring.
